notice: Synthetic HTML/CSS renders for the OCR benchmark (ADR-001 §14, D3). Grader names are plain printed text; card/comic art is abstract; names, titles and publishers are fictional. Cert numbers are test values. Never load live grader pages from tests.

metrics.top1: For fixtures with expected.number: the panel's top (selected) candidate equals expected.number exactly (leading zeros kept). Reported separately for category clean and degraded; negatives are excluded.
metrics.wrongAutoOpen: An automatically opened tab whose URL differs from the official URL built from expected.grader + expected.number, or any auto-open on a mustNotAutoOpen fixture. Hard blocker.

evaluation: A run passes a fixture when the observed status is in (accept ?? [expected.status]); when expected.number is non-null the top candidate must equal it exactly (string compare, leading zeros kept); when expected.grader is non-null the routed grader must equal it (a confirm result with an unresolved grader is reported separately, an auto-open with a different grader is a wrong auto-open); when graderUnresolved is true no grader may be pre-selected; mustNotAutoOpen fixtures must never auto-open; mustNotOpen URLs/hosts must never be navigated to or requested.
